remarks: This beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath ranch tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in one of Norwalk's most convenient locations. This home offers a blend of tranquility and accessibility, placing you just minutes from SONO and Connecticut Avenue, where you'll find endless options for shopping, dining, and a vibrant nightlife. Inside, you'll be greeted by a bright and inviting living space, where large windows flood the living and dining rooms with natural light. The wood-burning fireplace serves as a stunning focal point, perfect for cozy evenings. The kitchen boasts granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances, combining style and functionality. The spacious finished basement with its own lower-level access provides flexibility for a home office, guest suite, or recreation space. A one-car garage with interior access adds convenience, while the private backyard offers a serene retreat with a wooded upper level perfect for a fire pit or hammock. One of this home's most unique features is its direct trail access to Flax Hill Park, located right in your backyard! A popular destination for both locals and visitors, Flax Hill Park boasts lush greenery, picturesque walking paths, and scenic views, making it an ideal spot for leisurely strolls, picnics, or simply unwinding in nature. This home has been lovingly cared for and is ready for its next owner. Don't miss this rare opportunity to enjoy peaceful suburban living while staying close to all that Norwalk has to offer!
